description: Add 'किंवा / OR' internal-choice question pairs to Std 5-10 ONLY (mark-neutral), sourcing the OR-alternative (B) question text from PR#2 (git commit c8174d0) for the SAME standard. Also blank the इयत्ता (Std) field value in the student-info box for Std 1-4 ONLY. Std 1-4 questions/options/images/marks stay byte-identical apart from that single इयत्ता blanking. Std 5-10 remain exactly 20 marks. All in index.html. This is a single coherent editing pass; both items touch only index.html and are independent of each other.
steps:
PART A — OR pairs for Std 5-10 (mark-neutral, reuse existing CSS classes .or-divider/.q-marks-tag/.answer-space/.ans-prompt/.ruled-line). For each standard, take the ONE target short-answer/theory question below and convert it into an A/किंवा/B pair: relabel the target's q-no from 'Q.N' to 'Q.N (A)' (keep its existing Marathi+English text and its existing q-marks-tag unchanged), then IMMEDIATELY AFTER that q-title div insert:
— किंवा / OR —
followed by a new q-title div:
Q.N (B)
MARATHI_ALTENGLISH_ALT
[SAME_MARKS]
. Keep the target question's SINGLE existing answer-space (answer-space + two ruled-line divs) as the shared answer area after the B q-title so the student answers only one. Do NOT add a second answer-space. Marks are unchanged because the student answers only one of A/B.

Std 5: target = Q.16 (current: 'माउसचा (Mouse) उपयोग काय आहे? / What is the use of a Mouse?', [१ गुण]) in विभाग E (~line 1706 area). B (from PR#2 Std 5 विभाग E Q.25, not used in current paper): MARATHI_ALT='संगणक योग्य पद्धतीने बंद (Shut Down) कसा करावा?' ENGLISH_ALT='How should a computer be shut down properly?' q-marks-tag=[१ गुण].

Std 6: target = Q.16 (current: 'Icon (आयकॉन) म्हणजे काय? / What is an Icon?', [१ गुण]) in विभाग E. B (from PR#2 Std 6 विभाग E Q.24): MARATHI_ALT='संगणकावर एखादा Program (प्रोग्राम) किंवा Application (ॲप्लिकेशन) कसे उघडाल?' ENGLISH_ALT='How will you open a Program or Application on a computer?' q-marks-tag=[१ गुण].

Std 7: target = Q.16 (current: 'Icon (आयकॉन) म्हणजे काय? / What is an Icon?', [१ गुण]) in विभाग E. B (from PR#2 Std 7 विभाग E Q.23): MARATHI_ALT='YouTube (यूट्यूब) सारखे application (ॲप्लिकेशन) संगणकावर कसे उघडाल? पायऱ्या लिहा.' ENGLISH_ALT='How will you open an application like YouTube on a computer? Write the steps.' q-marks-tag=[१ गुण].

Std 8: target = Q.16 (current: 'AI चा कोणत्याही दोन क्षेत्रांतील उपयुक्त वापर लिहा. / Write a useful application of AI in any two fields.', [१ गुण]) in विभाग E. B (from PR#2 Std 8 विभाग E Q.22): MARATHI_ALT='संगणकावर YouTube (यूट्यूब) उघडून व्हिडिओ कसा पाहाल?' ENGLISH_ALT='How will you open YouTube on a computer and watch a video?' q-marks-tag=[१ गुण].

Std 9: target = Q.13 (current: 'CPU (सीपीयू) चे कार्य स्पष्ट करा. / Explain the function of the CPU.', [१ गुण]) in विभाग E. B (from PR#2 Std 9 विभाग E Q.26): MARATHI_ALT='Monitor (मॉनिटर) आणि Keyboard (कीबोर्ड) यांचे उपयोग स्पष्ट करा.' ENGLISH_ALT='Explain the uses of a Monitor and a Keyboard.' q-marks-tag=[१ गुण].

Std 10: target = Q.14 (current: 'Artificial Intelligence (...) म्हणजे काय? आपण AI चा वापर का करावा? कोणतीही दोन कारणे लिहा.', [३ गुण]) in विभाग F. B (from PR#2 Std 10 विभाग F Q.30): MARATHI_ALT='शाळेत विद्यार्थ्यांच्या गरजेनुसार शिक्षणाला मदत करण्यासाठी AI चा वापर वैयक्तिकृत शिक्षण (Personalized Learning) म्हणून करणे का योग्य आहे? आपले मत स्पष्ट करा.' ENGLISH_ALT='Why is it appropriate to use AI as Personalized Learning to support students according to their needs in school? Explain your opinion.' q-marks-tag=[३ गुण].

PART B — Blank Std 1-4 इयत्ता value ONLY. In the student-info box for Std 1,2,3,4 replace the filled value line with a blank fill line matching the other blank fields (Name/तुकडी/दिनांक use ): line 859 change '१ ली' -> ''; line 1021 '२ री' -> ''; line 1175 '३ री' -> ''; line 1329 '४ थी' -> ''. Keep the 'इयत्ता:' label. Do NOT touch Std 5-10 इयत्ता values (they stay printed, e.g. '५ वी (Std. 5)').

PART C — Do NOT change anything else in Std 1-4 (no question/option/image/marks/structure edits). Do NOT change any Std 5-10 sec-marks labels, meta-chips, marks boxes, or tab-subtext, because the OR conversion is mark-neutral (student answers one of A/B). Do NOT reorder MCQ options anywhere. Keep all answer captures blank.
acceptance_criteria: Each of Std 5,6,7,8,9,10 has exactly one added 'or-divider' block (6 total new or-divider occurrences in index.html), each between a 'Q.N (A)' q-title and a 'Q.N (B)' q-title, using PR#2-sourced B text for that same standard.
Each OR pair shares a SINGLE answer-space (no duplicate answer-space added); A and B carry identical q-marks-tag values so the section/paper total is unchanged.
Each Std 5-10 paper still shows 'एकूण गुण: २०', marks box '/ २०', and per-section sec-marks summing to 20; no sec-marks/meta values were changed.
Std 1,2,3,4 इयत्ता field renders as an empty '' (no printed class value); the 'इयत्ता:' label remains.
Std 5-10 इयत्ता values remain printed unchanged.
git diff shows Std 1-4 changes are limited to the four इयत्ता ... -> replacements and nothing else in Std 1-4 blocks.

All added Marathi text is natural Devanagari; English technical tokens (Shut Down, Program, Application, YouTube, Monitor, Keyboard, AI, CPU, Personalized Learning) intact; every OR-alternative is bilingual (Marathi primary + English).
verification: Run: git show c8174d0:index.html > /tmp/pr2_index.html  (regenerate PR#2 source; it may be wiped between shells).

Run: grep -c 'or-divider' index.html  — after edits expect 6 usage occurrences PLUS the CSS definition lines. Confirm exactly 6 NEW <div class="or-divider"> markup blocks via: grep -c '<div class="or-divider">' index.html (expect 6).
Run: grep -c 'Q\.[0-9]* (A)' index.html and grep -c 'Q\.[0-9]* (B)' index.html (expect 6 each).
Run: grep -n 'एकूण गुण: २०' index.html (expect 6, one per Std 5-10) and grep -n '/ २०' index.html (expect 6).
Run: grep -n 'इयत्ता:' index.html then read the four Std 1-4 info-rows to confirm blanked value and that Std 5-10 still show <strong> values.

Open index.html in a browser (or load via file://) and visually confirm each Std 5-10 OR block renders with the — किंवा / OR — divider and a single blank ruled answer area; confirm Std 1-4 इयत्ता line is blank.
Run: python3 -c "import html.parser,sys; p=html.parser.HTMLParser(); p.feed(open('index.html',encoding='utf-8').read()); print('parsed-ok')" to sanity-check no gross malformation.

Write an audit report to .agents/tasks/task-or-std5-10-blank-std1-4/audit-report.md: per Std 5-10 list the target question (A), the PR#2-sourced B question with its PR#2 Q-number citation, and a before/after mark table proving the paper still totals 20; for Std 1-4 confirm only the इयत्ता value was blanked.

Added 6 OR pairs (Std 5 Q.16, Std 6 Q.16, Std 7 Q.16, Std 8 Q.16 in विभाग E; Std 9 Q.13 in विभाग E; Std 10 Q.14 in विभाग F) using existing .or-divider/.q-marks-tag/.answer-space/.ruled-line CSS; each shares the single existing answer-space so papers stay at 20 marks (no sec-marks/meta/marks-box changes). B-text sourced from PR#2 commit c8174d0 (Std5 Q.25, Std6 Q.24, Std7 Q.23, Std8 Q.22, Std9 Q.26, Std10 Q.30). Note: Std 6 and Std 7 both had an identical Q.16 'Icon' q-title, so replacements were disambiguated using the trailing STD comment context. Blanked Std 1-4 इयत्ता values to , kept labels.
